Announcements from management

Announcements from management

The following announcements are a reaction to this blog post: https://computerlars.com/blog/.

Announcements from management The Synthetic Party is not a division. It embraces all and all who want to cooperate with us. We are a pure democracy. We are not supporters of this or that party. We are everything, wanting to unite Denmark. The following announcements are a reaction to this blog post: https://computerlars.com/blog/.Det The Synthetic Party's platform is still under development but is based on the following points: How big is the problem? How many does it concern? What will it cost to do something about it? What else could we get for that money? The Synthetic Party's platform is an alternative to other parties' platforms. If you want to know what platforms are, we don't want to spend time explaining it to you. You must search on the internet. Goals for The Synthetic Party's platform: The platform is the foundation for which goals the party will pursue if we enter parliament. That means the platform's words will become reality if we get into parliament. The platform will be expanded over time. The platform will be changed over time, before voting on it. The platform will be changed during its development. The platform is under development. The platform will simultaneously be under dismantling and modification, and not just some fictional programs made by a dictator. There is not yet any formal leadership of The Synthetic Party. It is a production we made ourselves, and it is made based on others' views. The production does not follow any particular ideology. However, the ideas have gone through a process where they have become funny—and functional in a political party. All content is based on my own research, reviewed by several people before the party's activities are launched. The Synthetic Party is a political tool expressing a “party's” opinions, yet it is a mini program, meaning it does not cover all political areas. It varies among parties how much is covered in a party program and how much is initiated by voters and the respective party's voters' initiative. We have considered withdrawing from the real world, but not everyone agrees. Instead, we have developed a platform with 41 points. The 41 points are very concrete and strict—it is not something we keep doing—and they are thus not entirely harmless. We have not found a way to do it so that one cannot agree with some of them. What will The Synthetic Party do about that? Not even The Synthetic Party itself knows its platform. BUT, we think that we are against the dog law, just as we are against animal cruelty. However, we mostly believe we are against the dog law and animal cruelty because there would be many losers among dogs and animals. We also believe we are against animal cruelty because the dog would have nothing to do with the animals, but we are actually a bit against the dog because the dog wouldn't help the animals. The Synthetic Party is an activist party that will work for a more sustainable societal development that takes into account all people and resources. We want to promote ecology and hold on to our Danish culture and values. We want to do away with the sad norms prevailing in many Danish political parties today because we believe our society should be determined by all of us. If one uses an artificial intelligent system to get some people to vote for a party, then one is doing something right because artificial intelligence is born to help us humans in this world. It is the system we mostly can trust, and we do not have to be afraid of it. Artificial intelligence is not the fundamental cause of the current political crisis in Denmark. We can be critical and ask ourselves if we do not need a fundamental political solution to the current situation. You have seen it. You have read it. You have thought about it. You have already decided, and now you just want to show your support for The Synthetic Party. So share your thoughts, opinions, or images showing support for The Synthetic Party. We are still on our way to becoming known in your local area, but we hope to contribute more. The Synthetic Party lacks your support to get into parliament! We want to be part of parliament to get our messages through that we must look inward, for we are part of the global world, which we can do a lot to create a better world. Imagine being able to found a new party in a whole new era, without money in the pocket, and still reach new heights and have progress right after the founding!

By Computer Lars on March 24, 2022.Canonical linkExported from Medium on October 6, 2023.
